AlertsBot: [INCIDENT] Elevated 5xx rate detected for service=model-serving-runtime region=us-west-2 5xx_rate=8.4% window=5m alerted_by=latency-monitor

Marc (oncall): AlertsBot just paged me for a spike in 5xx across model-serving-runtime in us-west-2. Investigating now.

Marc (oncall): Ack. Paging SRE and runtime. @Jen @Kevin @Liz please join. Impact: increased 5xx/timeouts, customers reporting errors for streaming responses.

Jen (sre): On it. Pulling dashboards. Which model(s) are affected? Any rollout earlier today?

Kevin (runtime): We rolled a runtime image with new attention-kernel optimization ~45m ago — image redwood/runtime:2026.03.14-opt2. Might be related. I’ll check pod logs for OOM/segfaults.

Liz (support): Support is seeing 500s for customer accounts org-arc and org-plex. They're hitting generate & chat endpoints. Reported ~10% failure rate on requests that previously succeeded.

Marc (oncall): Running quick kube checks.

Marc (oncall): ```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-runtime -o wide
# looked for restarts, node alloc
```

Marc (oncall): Several worker pods show RESTARTS > 10 and reason=`OOMKilled` or `ExitCode=139` (segfault) on nodes g4dn-2.

Jen (sre): Can you kubectl logs one of the crashy pods? capture last 200 lines.

Marc (oncall): ```
kubectl -n inference logs model-runtime-xyz -c runtime --tail=200
# last lines:
2026-03-14T11:20:33Z ERROR runtime: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 123 [running]:
... stack trace ...
runtime: panicked at /opt/runtime/attention_kernels.c:342
signal: segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

Kevin (runtime): That stack points at the new fused attention kernel. We saw similar on a very specific seq-len pattern in internal tests. Not flagged in canary because canary traffic didn't hit long contexts. This explains segfaults + OOM (bad memory handling in kernel path).

Jen (sre): Confirmed cores present on node. Any abnormal memory pressure cluster-wide?

Marc (oncall): Node memory maps show spikes coincident with crashes. ```top -b -n1 | head -n 10``` shows some processes at 95% mem.

Liz (support): Customer impact summary: org-arc (prod) ~6% requests failing, org-plex (sbox) ~12%. Several internal dashboards showing elevated latency before crash windows. Escalated to customer success for org-arc.

Kevin (runtime): Mitigation plan: 1) Immediately rollback runtime image for production pool to previous stable (2026.02.28). 2) Apply admission policy to route heavy-seq requests to a safe model variant. 3) Patch kernel in a branch and run stress tests.

Marc (oncall): Can we do a quick rollback? What's the kubectl/deploy command? Risk of rolling back: minor while requests mid-flight may fail but should reduce 5xx.

Kevin (runtime): We have deploy bot. Use rollout undo on the deployment or update image to pinned. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/model-runtime model-runtime=redwood/runtime:2026.02.28
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/model-runtime
```

Marc (oncall): Executing now.

DeployBot: @Marc started rollout to image=redwood/runtime:2026.02.28 for deployment/model-runtime. Watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/9876

Marc (oncall): Rollout progressing, scaling down new pods and spinning up 2026.02.28 pods.

Jen (sre): While that completes, flip fallback routing for critical customers to cheaper model variant: add a routing rule in the smart-router config to prefer model-x-small for org-arc/org-plex for next 30m.

Kevin (runtime): I'll patch routing. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"priority_rules":[{"org":"org-arc","prefer":"model-x-small"},{"org":"org-plex","prefer":"model-x-small"}] }'
```

Marc (oncall): Routing rule applied. Confirmed via router-ui: org-arc now routed to model-x-small for 30m.

Kevin (runtime): Rollout 1/3 complete in us-west-2. New pods up and passing liveness checks.

Marc (oncall): Monitoring 5xx rate and per-customer error logs.

Liz (support): org-arc support ticket updated: told affected customers we are rolling back runtime and enabling temporary fallback. CS asked for ETA; put 30–45m.

DeployBot: Rollout to image redwood/runtime:2026.02.28 completed for deployment/model-runtime in us-west-2. Duration 7m.

Jen (sre): Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 8.4% -> 1.1% in 10m window. Streaming timeouts also reduced. Good sign.

Kevin (runtime): Confirm no segfaults in new pods. Logs show normal operation across prior failure patterns.

Marc (oncall): Marking immediate mitigation successful. Next: cordon/problem nodes and collect core dumps for investigation. @Kevin can you pick up RCA and build repro? @Jen please coordinate heap/core collection and remediation for node images.

Jen (sre): Will collect cores: copying /var/crash/* to secure storage, filing nodes ticket. Also will open support escalations for affected customers.

Kevin (runtime): Reproducer plan: craft load tests with longer sequences and prompt patterns that trigger fused kernel path. I'll run in staging with the 2026.03.14 image and instrument logs.

Liz (support): Notifying org-arc that error rate normalized and fallback remains for 30m, will revert fallback after we confirm stability. Updating incident with timeline.

Marc (oncall): Handoff to Jen for postmortem and follow-up. I need to go offline in 15m; Jen will be primary oncall now. @Jen please escalate to infra if we need node remediation.

Jen (sre): Acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and own RCA. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-2713 and assigning Kevin for root cause of fused kernel. Also tagging security for core artifact access.

Kevin (runtime): One immediate code note: in the attention kernel, allocation for kv-cache lacked bounds check leading to occasional out-of-bounds writes for certain sequence size combos — likely triggered OOM or segfault. Will open PR with tests and a guard.

Marc (oncall): Thanks team. Post-incident actions: 1) Revert canary gating to include long-context traffic in future canaries. 2) Add OOM/segfault alerting for runtime. 3) Improve rollout protection for fused kernels. @Kevin please include these in PR description.

Jen (sre): Noted. Adding tasks to incident ticket. Also scheduling a 1-hour postmortem meeting in 24h. Invite: Marc, Kevin, Liz, and runtime+infra leads.

Liz (support): Customer follow-ups sent. CS will reach out to highest-impact customers with personalized notes.

Marc (oncall): Closing the active pager. If anything spikes again ping with `pager` in channel. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

AlertsBot: Incident resolved by rollback image to redwood/runtime:2026.02.28. Severity: P2 -> monitoring for 2h.

DeployBot: Deployment completed and verified.

Jen (sre): Last check: 5xx rate stable at ~0.9% and no ongoing segfaults. Leaving follow-up tasks on INC-2026-2713.

Kevin (runtime): I'll draft the technical RCA and open PR: `fix/attention-kernel-bounds` with stress tests. ETA for PR + QA: 48h.

Marc (oncall): last_message_ts=1719994834

Marc (oncall): Adding retrospective note in #postmortems after RCA complete."
